recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Vocabulary wants stronger narrative about display quality; the structural elements and non-processing semantics requested by FHIR-12617 are already present in current build-scoped source.
issue_request: FHIR-12617 was a Published Vocabulary change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to add display text to ConceptMap.group.element and ConceptMap.group.element.target. The approved resolution selected 0..1 display elements and required documentation that the optional strings are only for convenience, not for matching or $translate lookup, and may be insufficient to judge map quality.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite svn revision 11144. The matching git-svn commit 7ad0c6364e2c36a9bc3d92cb70f7aa22231970c3 is titled "#12590 & #12617 - add default mappings and display to ConceptMap" and added ConceptMap.group.element.display and ConceptMap.group.element.target.display as 0..1 string rows in the then-authoritative ConceptMap spreadsheet, with display-for-editing definitions and processing-ignore comments.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml is current build-scoped source. Later source refactors preserved the requested display elements in that StructureDefinition. FHIR-12590 was applied in the same historical commit but concerns ConceptMap unmapped/default behavior, so it was treated as same-change-family context rather than decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because ConceptMap.group.element.display and ConceptMap.group.element.target.display are both present as 0..1 string elements, and both comments say display is ignored when processing the map.

related_jiras.note: The same svn/git application commit also added ConceptMap unmapped/default behavior, but that is a separate request and is not needed to decide FHIR-12617.
